challenge.method: Challenged the name as a potential product, IDE, runtime or VBA-version alias with the migration table, Microsoft's support statement (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/previous-versions/visualstudio/visual-basic-6/visual-basic-6-support-policy), and the VBA 6 and earlier discussion (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/office/vba/language/concepts/getting-started/64-bit-visual-basic-for-applications-overview).
challenge.results: The lifecycle statement uses the same VB6 name for a product with separately listed IDE and runtime deliverables. The VBA documentation independently uses version 6 within the Office language family. The table's language-type context fixes the candidate's referent.

limitations: The reviewed identity is the language edition. The review makes no assessment of product lifecycle or compatibility for a particular compiler or runtime version.
